about.metaDescription: Learn about TropiNord's mission, roots, ethical sourcing, and commitment to sustainable wellness. Founded in Sweden by Paul Abejegah.
about.heading: About TropiNord
about.subheading: Our story, our values, our mission
about.ourStoryContent:
TropiNord is a Swedish wellness brand rooted in sustainability, cultural heritage, and ethical trade. We bring together the clarity and precision of the Nordic lifestyle with the deep, time-honored traditions of Africa and the Pacific.

Our foundation is built on respect for nature, for people, and for the knowledge passed down through generations. From Sweden's clean, forested landscapes to the sun-warmed soils of Africa and the Pacific Islands, every ingredient is selected for its purity, potency, and purpose.

At TropiNord, sustainability isn't a trend, it's a principle. Our products and partnerships reflect:

❄️ Nordic standards, thoughtful sourcing, clean production, and uncompromising quality
🌿 Global wisdom drawing from ancestral knowledge of herbs, oils, and holistic wellness
🌍 Shared responsibility protecting ecosystems, supporting small producers, and honoring heritage

This is more than wellness. It's a connection between worlds, one that celebrates people, planet, and the power of tradition.
about.missionQuote: “As part of our mission, TropiNord is proud to develop a line of products specifically for Afro-European customers, combining African botanical wisdom with Nordic purity.”
about.valuesContent: TropiNord is more than a shop. It is a platform created to support people. Guided by a deep sense of purpose, our goal is to empower small producers, promote eco-conscious living, and help customers reconnect with nature through simple, honest products.
about.whatWeDoItem1: Import and distribute organic oils, natural soaps, and wellness items
about.whatWeDoItem2: Work hand in hand with small producers in Africa, Sweden, and other regions
about.whatWeDoItem3: Provide support and visibility to local makers
about.whatWeDoItem4: Sell through online channels, with plans for retail expansion
about.whatWeDoExtra: We also collaborate with small business owners and startups by offering them space to grow. By featuring their products on the TropiNord platform, we support local and international visibility, helping to increase awareness and build customer trust.
about.ourMissionContent: Our mission is to create a genuine link between tradition, nature, and quality. TropiNord exists to support sustainable trade and celebrate cultural diversity through products that reflect care, craft, and community.

services.title: Our Services
services.collabText: Reach out and let's bring your project to life.

organicOils.title: Organic Oils
organicOils.desc: Cold-pressed coconut, neem, baobab, and almond oils.
organicOils.detail: Our organic oils such as baobab, coconut, neem, and almond, are ethically cold-pressed from trusted cooperatives in Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean. Each batch is unrefined and rich in nutrients, perfect for wellness, skincare, or culinary use. We prioritize purity, fair trade, and full traceability.

naturalSoaps.title: Natural Soaps
naturalSoaps.desc: African black soap, shea soap, and herbal blends.
naturalSoaps.detail: Our natural soaps include traditional African black soap, shea butter bars, and custom herbal blends infused with moringa, turmeric, and neem. Crafted using age-old methods and sustainably harvested ingredients, these soaps offer a gentle yet powerful cleansing experience while supporting local artisans.

agroImports.title: Agro & Raw Material Imports
agroImports.desc: Farm produce, herbs, and eco-packaging from the tropics.
agroImports.detail: We import niche agro-based materials and eco-products such as banana leaves, cassava flour, dried herbs, and biodegradable packaging. Our sourcing network spans across Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean—supporting clean-label brands, restaurants, and sustainable retailers in the Nordics.

logistics.title: Retail & Logistics Support
logistics.detail: Our logistics service is designed for micro-brands and solo entrepreneurs. We help with warehousing, labeling, Nordic-friendly packaging, and last-mile delivery within Sweden and the EU. Whether you're launching a herbal product or a new snack, our support gets you retail-ready.

ecoSourcing.title: Eco-Sourcing Partnerships
ecoSourcing.detail: We believe in ethical, earth-friendly trade. Our eco-sourcing connects you to small-scale growers using regenerative farming and agroecology. We co-develop supply chains with producers in underrepresented regions, ensuring fair prices, sustainable yields, and storytelling that sells.

community.title: Community Outreach
community.detail: Our outreach focuses on youth empowerment, food education, and green entrepreneurship. Through mentorship, workshops, and sports-led programs, we help bridge rural talent and urban markets—from grassroots in West Africa to integration hubs in Scandinavia.

WhatIsTropinord.a: TropiNord is a brand that blends tropical traditions with Nordic quality, offering organic products like oils, natural skincare, and more. We will also be expanding into plant-based milk in the near future.

productsOffered.q: What kind of products do you offer?
productsOffered.a: We offer organic oils, traditional African soaps, agro-imports, and eco-packaging. All our products are ethically sourced and support small producers.

organicSourcing.a: Yes, we focus on cold-pressed, unrefined, and organically grown ingredients. We work with cooperatives that follow organic and sustainable farming practices.

plantMilk.a: Not yet, but we're developing a line of tropical plant-based milk alternatives sourced from Africa, coming soon!

shipsFrom.a: We ship from our logistics base in Sweden and serve customers across the EU.

shippingPolicy.a: Orders are processed in 1–3 business days. Within Sweden: delivery in 2–5 days. International: 7–21 days. Fees and tracking info are provided at checkout. International customers are responsible for duties and taxes.

returnPolicy.a: You can return items within 14 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Personal care or perishable goods can't be returned unless faulty. Contact support@tropinord.com to initiate a return.

contactSupport.q: How can I contact customer support?
contactSupport.a: You can reach us via our contact form or email info@tropinord.com. We aim to respond within 24–48 hours.
